subject: general
question: What does the UN Environment Programme's (UNEP) "An Eye on Methane: From Measurement to Momentum" report highlight about India?

options.text: India’s role in the Global Methane Pledge
India’s climate policies under the Paris Agreement
India’s commitment to carbon neutrality by 2050

solution: The correct answer is __**"India’s role in the Global Methane Pledge"**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • The UN Environment Programme (UNEP) released the fifth edition of its report "An Eye on Methane: From Measurement to Momentum" prepared by IMEO.
